THE EARLY ACCESS SHELF

Ready for your
home screen.

These are signed APKs for testing on Android phones and tablets. They are free to download and are not Google Play releases. They cannot be installed on iPhone or iPad.

Check each app’s setup requirements below. Use Wi-Fi if you want to avoid mobile data charges. Installing a newer build does not guarantee compatibility with saved test data.

SideQuest

Connect to the internet and sign in to use groups, activities, plans and shared memories. This build is configured for hosted Firebase and Supabase services. Service availability and account flows have not been retested as part of this website release.

Haste

Haste is an Android test build with local food journaling, hosted Firebase accounts, food search, and optional AI estimates through the Haste API. Review estimates before saving. Journals in previous test packages do not transfer automatically.

Revisen

A reachable Revisen backend is required for accounts, course materials and practice. No public backend is supplied by this download. Ask the person running your test for their server URL and enter it in the app’s Connection settings. Installing the APK alone is not enough to use the learning workspace.

About these builds

APKs are hosted as public GitHub Release assets; you do not need a GitHub account to download them. All three files passed Android APK signature verification. Their sizes and SHA-256 hashes were checked before publishing. This verifies the files, not every app feature or compatibility with every phone.
